# Brave Hearts Family Corp

> Residential assisted living in St. Cloud, Minnesota. A warm, home-like residence where clients feel cherished and secure.

Brave Hearts Family Corp provides personalized assisted living at 1702 9th Ave SE, St Cloud, MN 56304. Caregivers are available around the clock. The home is for seniors seeking a place to call home, with private rooms, support for daily activities, and a sense of community.

## Healthcare

Residential assisted living in St. Cloud, Minnesota. The healthcare services below are the care and support stated on the page. Nyadoar Banzir Dojiok, Registered Nurse (RN), is on the team. Patient Care Assistants assist with daily activities and personal care. The home accepts some public and private insurance plans. Plan names are not listed. License number, bed count, star rating, review quotes, and prices are not stated on the site.

- Personalized Care Plans: every resident receives an individualized care plan designed around their health, preferences, and daily routine.
- Medication Management: trained caregivers assist with medication reminders and administration.
- Nutritious Home-Cooked Meals: well-balanced meals prepared daily. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are reserved, and snacks are provided every day.
- Assistance with Daily Living: bathing, dressing, grooming, mobility, and other daily activities, while encouraging independence.
- 24/7 Compassionate Support: caregivers are available around the clock.
- Social and Recreational Activities: activities for social connection, mental stimulation, and well-being. Scheduled activities and events cover a range of interests.
- Housekeeping and Laundry: routine housekeeping and laundry.
- Safe and Comfortable Living: secure entrances, private accommodations, and welcoming community spaces.
- On-site Laundry Access
- Indoor and Outdoor Dining Areas
- Weekly Fitness Plan
- Local Garden Walks
- Security: 24/7 staff - main gate lock - individual room locks
- Outside Fitness Instructor: upon request
- Minnesota Home Care Bill of Rights: https://www.health.state.mn.us/facilities/regulation/billofrights/docs/mn_hcbor_eng_reg.pdf

## The home

- Rooms are furnished with comfortable beds, storage, and easy access to a bathroom with a low-curb shower.
- 1–2 people per room. Spouses who both live in the program may share a room if both agree and it is not medically contraindicated.
- Room features: fully furnished, bed linens, room-darkening shades, clothing storage, individual locks.
- Bedding, towels, and essential toiletries are provided. The kitchen is equipped with pans, dishes, cookware, wine glasses, a toaster, a coffee maker, and coffee.
- Shared living space: TV, sound system, board games.
- Shared kitchen: refrigerator, freezer, microwave, dishwasher, stove, oven, toaster, trash compactor, pots and pans, dishes and silverware, dining table.
- Bathroom: low-curb shower, cleaning supplies, body soap, toilet paper, towels.
- Laundry: washer, dryer, iron, drying rack.
- Also on site: air conditioning and heating, Wi-Fi, patio or balcony, BBQ grill, free parking, smoke alarms, fire extinguisher, first aid kit.
- Floor plans are shown on the page as Floor Plan 1 and Floor Plan 2.
- The kitchen area is off limits when unsupervised, for resident safety.

## Financing and hiring

- The home accepts some public and private insurance plans. The page does not list plan names or prices.
- Patient Care Assistant (PCA) roles are open. A PCA assists with daily activities and personal care. Interest goes through the contact form to info@braveheartsfamily.com. A resume can be uploaded there as a PDF or Word file up to 10 MB.

## House rules

The home is smoke-free. Assault or abuse, stealing, destruction of property, vulgar or abusive speech, illicit drugs, and alcohol are not permitted. Music and nighttime television stay at a reasonable volume. No loitering outside. Late arrivals should give the manager advance notice. Visits are allowed at any time. Overnight visits are limited to emergencies. Meals are reserved for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and snacks are available every day.

## Resident rights

The page lists assisted living resident rights, including dignity, adequate care, privacy, freedom from abuse and restraints, confidentiality, managing personal affairs, clergy visits, personal clothing, private visits, grievances without retaliation, correspondence, roommate notice, a common telephone, participating in the service plan, and refusing treatment after the consequences are explained. Residents are not assigned work without consent. A Medicaid Waiver resident may not be assigned work for the program.

- Minnesota Home Care Bill of Rights: https://www.health.state.mn.us/facilities/regulation/billofrights/docs/mn_hcbor_eng_reg.pdf
